newsitem.title: GERMANY: German VAW in joint venture in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: German VAW in joint venture in Turkey.

text.p: VAW Aluform System-Technik GmbH, a subsidiary of VAW Aluminium AG, said it had entered into a joint venture with a Turkish company, Pekintas AS, to produce and distribute aluminium products for the building industry.
VAW is a unit of the diversified utility Viag AG.
A VAW statement said the two comapnies would form a 50/50 joint venture at the end of this year, with Pekintas providing the site and buildings and VAW the products.
Istanbul-based Pekintas, with annual sales of 85 million marks, produces industrial units and storage facilities. --Hamburg newsroom, +49-40-41903275
